The Soul Anthem
"The Unspoken Guardians exists because there are those who protect in silence —
parents who sacrifice without speaking, teachers who guide without reward.

We are built on the ancient soil of Lakshmanpur,
where Lakshmana once stood on a high mound
to protect his people from the floods of the Gomti.

Today, we offer that same high ground — digitally —
to anyone facing the floods of financial crisis,
educational barriers, or mental anguish.

This is our Anjali — our sincere offering.
Guided by Progress. Illuminated by Light. Sweetened by Love."
— Pragati Singh, Founder · The Unspoken Guardians · Lucknow (Lakshmanpur), Uttar Pradesh, India
